  - Legitimate security tools performing self‑checks

arguments.summary: Credential compromise on finance workstation WS-FIN-042. Attackers leveraged a malicious rundll32 payload from the Temp directory to establish a Cobalt Strike beacon to external C2 server 198.51.100.23. Lateral movement via SMB and attempted Kerberos abuse were observed. Containment actions blocked the C2 IP and isolated the host. Root cause identified as stolen user credentials (CORP\jsmith) and execution of unsigned binary.

SMB file access to 10.0.5.50 – lateral movement attempt to file server.
Containment: firewall rule added to block IP 198.51.100.23 (Cobalt Strike C2).
User credential reset for CORP\jsmith and session termination on WS-FIN-042.
